prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 6 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1223; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The injury does not fit the crash: the impact was very light, yet the claimed injury is severe.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and limited cervical range of motion. Over six visits, conservative management was provided, including manual therapy, stretching exercises, and a home exercise program. Treatment progressed in a typical pattern, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved and the patient regained function. On examination, paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced rotation were documented and are consistent with a soft tissue strain. Neurological screening, including reflexes, strength, and sensation in the upper extremities, was within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury to the cervical region. Billing records reflect only the services clinically indicated, with no duplicated or repeated charges. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise and as-needed follow-up.
